newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Two killed in ambush on Somalia aid convoy.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in ambush on Somalia aid convoy.

text.p: Two Somali security guards were killed and six others wounded when heavily-armed gunmen ambushed an Italian aid convoy 180 km (105 miles) north of Mogadishu, local residents reported on Sunday.

The convoy of five vehicles belonging to the Commitato Italiano Servicio de Populi (CISP - Italian Service Committee) was returning to Mogadishu after delivering drugs and other supplies to the El-Dher district.
It was ambushed on Saturday at a roadblock in El-Gudud Mosque village, which is under control of Somali warlord Ali Mahdi Mohamed.
CISP staff members told reporters the wounded included five CISP guards and a Somali woman working for the agency. They were evacuated to a Red Cross hospital in Mogadishu.
Two of the attackers were also wounded.
Reports from the area said the incident appeared to arise from inter-faction rivalry following the hijack of a lorry.
